Hi Bethany — Aditya here (SE). I’ll respond to the telemetry/cookie and retention questions below with concrete, short answers you can pass to security. I’ve attached a small cookie matrix and our retention policy excerpt for reference.

Q: Do you ever log raw cookie values or personally-identifying cookie IDs in hosted logs?
A: No. In our hosted product (Redwood API + Console): we do not persist raw cookie value strings in production logs. Identifiers used for telemetry are pseudo-identifiers generated by the client (first-party cookie IDs or session IDs). When those are collected for event correlation we hash (SHA-256) and truncate the token before storage. We do not map hashes back to PII in the hosted environment. For Dedicated/Private customers, telemetry can be configured to avoid sending identifiers to Redwood (customer-managed).

Q: Where are telemetry logs stored (region)? Are they replicated cross-region?
A: Hosted telemetry is stored in the region you select for your account (we have US, EU, APAC regions). Logs are stored within that region by default; we replicate to a secondary region only for high-availability plans or when configured by the customer (Dedicated/Enterprise). We can provide region-level manifests for SOC2 review on request.

Q: Default retention for raw logs vs aggregated metrics?
A: Defaults for hosted accounts: raw diagnostic logs (request traces, expanded debug logs) = 90 days; aggregated usage and billing metrics = 13 months. We offer retention configuration for Dedicated customers and an Enterprise add-on for longer retention windows.

Q: Any third-party trackers or analytics on the docs site or console?
A: Public docs: we run a lightweight analytics stub (first-party Google Analytics measurement ID) on the docs.redwood.com site for product metrics; no FullStory or session replay tools are included by default. The Console (customer UI) does not load third-party marketing trackers. For customers that need absolute assurance, we have a docs-only build option with analytics disabled.

Other notes:
- SOC 2: We completed a SOC 2 Type II in June 2026; the full report is available under NDA. Please use https://redwood.com/soc2-request to request access.
- HIPAA/BAA: We support BAAs for covered workloads on our hosted service; for customers requiring on-prem or air-gapped deployments we provide Private deployment options and a separate BAA/contract path.
- Data subject requests (GDPR): Hosted customers can subscribe to API endpoints for automated subject request handling; we also provide a manual portal for ad-hoc requests.

Attachments: console-cookie-matrix.csv (mapping of cookies/event types), rdwd_telemetry_retention_policy.txt (excerpt)
